items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer edit. Repaint the supplied game card 二刀流 while STRICTLY preserving its original composition, camera viewpoint, blade geometry and framing. The original image is the composition authority. Preserve the two dominant long silver blades crossing into a large X with the crossing point slightly below center, their hilts at the bottom left/right, and the additional cropped metallic blade sections entering from both lower corners exactly where they are. Keep the warm orange collision sparks centered on that same intersection. Keep the pale moon at top center, distant mountain silhouettes, dark sloping shores, the horizontal water horizon and broad moon reflection down the middle. No person, hand or character. Do not redesign the composition or change the number/positions/directions of visible blades. Repaint as rough hand-painted anime color study: large connected opaque masses, few wide directional swipes and blunt dabs, handmade hard shadow edges, matte muted slate blue/charcoal colors and concentrated warm spark accents. Simplify hilt decoration into readable principal shapes; simplify water into broad horizontal brush bands and moon reflection into a few broken pale color masses; simplify sparks into a small number of bold orange marks. Quiet coarse regions, no dense hairline detail, glossy photoreal finish, facet mosaics or all-over texture filters. Preserve the original moonlit water scene using broad abstracted planes rather than replacing its scenery. Single square illustration, no text/frame/watermark/UI.
